top_story.headline: WPP's Gulf Hill & Knowlton registers to run Abu Dhabi's U.S. tourism campaign
top_story.dek: The new FARA registrant is a branch of a WPP plc subsidiary, and its foreign principal is the Abu Dhabi government's culture and tourism department.
paragraphs: Gulf Hill & Knowlton WLL (Creative Zone Branch) registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act on October 22, 2026 (registration #7784). Its foreign principal is the United Arab Emirates, Department of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi. The Exhibit AB checks the box identifying the principal as a government of a foreign country. Exhibit AB.

In the registration statement, the registrant describes itself as a branch under Gulf Hill and Knowlton CO. W.L.L., an indirect subsidiary of WPP plc. It lists one individual rendering services for the principal, Jessica Emily Margaret Macdonald, who filed a short-form registration. Her services are described as communications support for the principal's tourism campaign in the United States, including management of a content partnership between AFAR Media and the foreign principal.

sections.headline: Routine disclosures only; no divestitures or terminations filed
paragraphs: Fifty-six ethics filings were processed in the three-day window (October 22–24), all routine annual or periodic disclosures from prior reporting years. No new divestiture certificates, termination notices, or ethics agreements appeared.

sections.headline: One new registrant, for the Abu Dhabi government; a day of informational-materials filings
paragraphs: One new registrant and 14 filed documents came in since October 22. The input lists no terminated registrants and no new or dropped foreign principals for existing registrants.

items: Gulf Hill & Knowlton WLL (Creative Zone Branch) (#7784) registered October 22 for the United Arab Emirates, Department of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates). The Exhibit AB and registration statement describe public relations, communications and corporate advisory work, with the principal's U.S. tourism campaign and an AFAR Media content partnership as the stated services. An Exhibit C was also filed. Registrant listing: new registrant record.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
